 Pistons’ Ausar Thompson dazzles with behind-the-back slam dunk
 Ausar Thompson threw down an incredible dunk during the first half of the Pistons' win over the Heat on Friday night.
 By Richard Pereira • Oct 23, 2026 at 11:27 PM ET • 1 min read Add ClutchPoints on Google Rick Osentoski-Imagn Images Ausar Thompson wowed opposing fans with an incredible dunk highlight during the Detroit Pistons' matchup against the Miami Heat on Friday night.
 Thompson started the fourth season of his young NBA career with the Pistons. He stands out as one of the best rising stars, shining with his talents as a defender while improving as an all-around player.
 Thompson also has a knack for showing off his athleticism. He put that on full display during Detroit's road opener against Miami.
 The highlight took place during the second quarter. Cade Cunningham had the ball as he passed it to John Collins, who lobbed it up to Thompson as he finished the play by throwing it down in reverse fashion.
